title: Fixed-Point Arithmetic (Q16.16)
function_name: fp_from_int / fp_to_int / fp_add / fp_sub / fp_mul / fp_div

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Q16.16 value to convert to integer

constraints: Q16.16 in signed 32-bit integer; scaling factor 65536
fp_mul and fp_div MUST use a 64-bit (int64_t) intermediate
Correct for negative values (arithmetic shifts preserve sign)
